faq.question: Can Birdcast create videos for companies?
faq.answer: Yes. Birdcast supports professional business video content for companies, departments, leadership teams and agencies.

faq.question: Can we record internal communication videos?
faq.answer: Yes. The studio can support internal updates, training, onboarding, leadership messages and company communication.

faq.question: Can Birdcast support marketing videos?
faq.answer: Yes. Companies can use Birdcast for branded content, campaign videos, social assets and company stories.

faq.question: Can one company shoot produce multiple assets?
faq.answer: Yes. A single planned production session can often create a main video plus shorter clips for different channels.

faq.question: What details should a company send first?
faq.answer: Send the brief, audience, usage channels, number of speakers, deadline and whether the video is internal or public.
